proposed_widenings.name: composite_magic_item_mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item surface only allows one mechanics family at a time (`passive` or `activation`). Staff of Fire needs a passive fire-resistance grant while held and an independent charge-based spellcasting payload with dawn recharge and last-charge destruction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You have Resistance to Fire damage while you hold this staff." / "The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it..."

notes: Not authored into content because any single-family encoding would omit either the passive resistance or the charge-based spellcasting half.
